title: A Note on Generalized Parabolic Marcinkiewicz Integrals with Grafakos-Stefanov Kernels
content: This paper focuses on studying the generalized Marcinkiewicz integral operators with mixed homogeneity. Under the Grafakos-Stefanov condition on their kernel functions, the Lp boundedness of these operators is established. The main results generalize and improve some previously known results.
